verdict.rationale: DBOS documents Postgres-backed queues with flow control, meaning limits on how many workflows run at once and how often they start (dbos-docs-6, dbos-docs-26). That only glancingly touches scheduling control. Nothing in the evidence shows priority assignment or tenant-fair scheduling as an alternative to FIFO. Missing for 10: documented per-run priority levels, per-tenant fairness or partitioned queues, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of non-FIFO scheduling behavior.
